# Which Drake source files the ORVD rigid multibody runtime admits, and why.
#
# This file is the sole authority for the vendor boundary and for the exact
# upstream revision. Nothing else in the repository restates those values: the
# same fact written twice drifts, and the drifted copy gets used as truth.
#
# Read by tools/drake_source_boundary/calculate_required_drake_source_closure.py.
# Candidate directories identify the exact sets whose admitted files seed the
# walk; they do not admit files by prefix. Every candidate and support file still
# needs its own disposition. An edge to an unclassified or forbidden file fails.
# All paths are relative to the Drake source root.
#
# Dispositions:
#   vendor         copied into ORVD and compiled.
#   first_party    not copied; ORVD implements this role itself.
#   reference_only not copied and not compiled; read to guide an ORVD pass.
#   discard        not needed today. Not an architectural violation; a later
#                  goal may admit it after a fresh decision.
#   forbidden      violates the runtime boundary. The closure reaching it is a
#                  defect, not a decision to revisit.
#
# `discard` and `forbidden` are deliberately distinct. Collapsing them would make
# "we do not need this" and "this must never be here" produce the same
# diagnostic, and the second one is the only one worth waking someone up for.
#
# Only negative category rules take a prefix. There is deliberately no
# `vendor_prefix`: admitting a directory wholesale would silently admit whatever
# upstream adds to it later, which is exactly the case the unclassified-edge
# failure exists to catch.

source_repository https://github.com/RobotLocomotion/drake.git
source_commit 231c260201ee2f7d101a8d9ccede78626f7ca13a
source_tag v1.54.0
license_spdx BSD-3-Clause
license_file LICENSE.TXT
candidate_directory multibody/tree
candidate_directory multibody/topology

# The repository-level Drake license is BSD-3-Clause. The candidate tree/topology
# files carry no per-file notice, but two admitted support files retain existing
# Stanford copyright and Apache-2.0 notices, and the corresponding license text
# ships with them.
#
# No copyright header is invented for a file that never had one: doing so would
# misstate provenance rather than preserve it. That is a different matter from a
# notice a license the file already carries requires of us. Apache-2.0 section
# 4(b) obliges a modified file to say that we modified it, so an admitted
# Apache-2.0 file that ORVD changes carries such a notice below its original
# header, with the original untouched and no ORVD copyright claim added.
file_license common/copyable_unique_ptr.h Apache-2.0
file_license common/nice_type_name.cc Apache-2.0

# --- Category exclusions ------------------------------------------------------
# These are architecture, not preference. Each names a subsystem whose types
# would drag a dependency the ORVD runtime is defined not to have.

forbidden_prefix geometry/  # scene graph, proximity queries and mesh types; the runtime is geometry-free by construction
forbidden_prefix multibody/fem/  # finite element models for deformable bodies; ORVD is rigid-body only
forbidden_prefix multibody/plant/  # MultibodyPlant is the System-level assembly ORVD replaces with its own model-neutral layer
forbidden_prefix multibody/contact_solvers/  # contact solvers and their SAP/TAMSI machinery; no contact in the admitted runtime
forbidden_prefix multibody/meshcat/  # visualization
forbidden_prefix solvers/  # mathematical program formulations and solver bindings

# --- Split implementations ----------------------------------------------------
# A header whose implementation does not share its stem. The closure cannot infer
# these, so an omission here becomes a link failure much later; declaring them
# makes the analyzer walk into them now.

implementation multibody/tree/body_node_impl.h multibody/tree/body_node_impl_mass_matrix.cc
implementation multibody/topology/spanning_forest.h multibody/topology/spanning_forest_debug.cc

# link_joint_graph_debug.cc is deliberately not declared here. It implements only
# GenerateGraphvizString and MakeGraphvizFiles, which link_joint_graph.h declares
# but nothing on the rigid solve path calls; declaring the relation would make the
# closure demand a file we already decided against. If that call ever appears, it
# surfaces as an undefined symbol at link time, which is what G11 and G17 are for.

# --- Per-file dispositions ----------------------------------------------------

# topology
vendor multibody/topology/forest.h  # Umbrella header that sets DRAKE_MULTIBODY_TOPOLOGY_FOREST_INCLUDED and pulls spanning_forest.h plus the nested Mobod/Tree/LoopConstraint/inlines fragments in the one include order that actually compiles.
vendor multibody/topology/graph.h  # Umbrella header that sets DRAKE_MULTIBODY_TOPOLOGY_GRAPH_INCLUDED and pulls link_joint_graph.h plus the nested Link/LoopConstraint/Joint/inlines fragments in dependency order; every user of LinkJointGraph includes this file, not the fragments.
vendor multibody/topology/link_joint_graph.cc  # Implements AddLink/AddJoint/RemoveJoint/ChangeJointType, AddShadowLink for loop breaking, AddToWeldedLinksAssembly accumulation, RenumberMobodIndexes after depth-first reordering, and the graph queries FindPathFromWorld/FindFirstCommonAncestor/FindSubtreeLinks/CalcLinksWeldedTo.
vendor multibody/topology/link_joint_graph.h  # Declares LinkJointGraph: AddLink/AddJoint/RegisterJointType, the JointTraits record (name, nq, nv, has_quaternion) that drives coordinate counting, WeldedLinksAssembly grouping, ephemeral shadow-link/joint bookkeeping, and ownership of the SpanningForest that MultibodyTree's mobilizer numbering is derived from.
discard multibody/topology/link_joint_graph_debug.cc  # Contains only GenerateGraphvizString() and MakeGraphvizFiles(), which write .dot files and invoke Graphviz; nothing here computes graph or forest structure. G13 deletes their declarations from the vendored header in the same change so ORVD does not publish an API that only fails when linked.
vendor multibody/topology/link_joint_graph_defs.h  # Defines JointTraitsIndex/WeldedLinksAssemblyIndex/LoopConstraintIndex and the LinkFlags/JointFlags/ForestBuildingOptions bitmask enums (kStatic, kMassless, kMustBeBaseBody, kUseFixedBase, kUseRpyFloatingJoints, kOptimizeWeldedLinksAssemblies) that steer how BuildForest chooses base bodies and composites.
vendor multibody/topology/link_joint_graph_inlines.h  # Inline accessors that resolve LinkIndex/JointIndex through the index-to-ordinal maps to Link/Joint references, plus set_primary_mobod_for_link and set_mobod_for_joint used on the hot path of forest building.
vendor multibody/topology/link_joint_graph_joint.h  # Defines LinkJointGraph::Joint holding parent/child LinkIndex (the user's sign convention), the JointTraitsIndex used to test for welds, connects() adjacency queries, and the how_modeled_ variant recording which Mobod (or none, for an unmodeled weld) realizes this joint.
vendor multibody/topology/link_joint_graph_link.h  # Defines LinkJointGraph::Link holding the joints_as_parent/joints_as_child adjacency lists that the forest traversal walks, attached loop constraints, the mobod_ back-reference set during modeling, welded-links-assembly membership, and the massless/static/shadow flags.
vendor multibody/topology/link_joint_graph_loop_constraint.h  # Defines LinkJointGraph::LoopConstraint, the graph-level weld record pairing a primary link with the shadow link created when a cycle was cut, fixing the parent/child ordering that sets the constraint multipliers' sign convention.
vendor multibody/topology/spanning_forest.cc  # Implements BuildForest: base-body choice policy and ConnectLinksToWorld, level-by-level ExtendTrees, HandleLoopClosure via AddShadowMobod, GrowAssemblyMobod for welded composites, CreateDepthFirstReordering with FixupForestToUseNewNumbering, and AssignCoordinates that lays out q and v.
vendor multibody/topology/spanning_forest.h  # Declares SpanningForest: the depth-first Mobod ordering, per-tree partitioning of Mobods, the q/v coordinate assignment and its inverse maps (q_to_mobod, v_to_mobod, link_to_tree_index), welded-mobods groupings, and path/common-ancestor queries — this is the topology that MultibodyTree's inboard-outboard recursions iterate over.
vendor multibody/topology/spanning_forest_debug.cc  # Sole definition of SpanningForest::SanityCheckForest(), which vendored spanning_forest.cc:176 calls via DRAKE_ASSERT_VOID at the end of BuildForest() — armed in every non-NDEBUG build, so omitting it is a link error unless vendored source is patched; it re-verifies assembly levels, mobod inboard/outboard consistency and the q/v coordinate assignment, and depends only on drake_assert.h and topology/forest.h, both already vendored.
vendor multibody/topology/spanning_forest_inlines.h  # Inline lookups defined after Mobod/Tree are complete: mobods(index), mobod_to_active_link_ordinal, mobod_to_link_ordinals, and the q_to_tree_index/v_to_tree_index/link_to_tree_index maps that per-tree kinematics and mass-matrix loops index with.
vendor multibody/topology/spanning_forest_loop_constraint.h  # Defines SpanningForest::LoopConstraint pairing the primary and shadow MobodIndex for a cut link, with FixupAfterReordering to remap both indices after depth-first renumbering.
vendor multibody/topology/spanning_forest_mobod.cc  # Out-of-line Mobod constructors (the World special case with zero coordinates, and the general case taking link/joint ordinals plus level and reversed flag) and FixupAfterReordering/RenumberMobodIndexVector that remap inboard and outboard indices after the depth-first renumber.
vendor multibody/topology/spanning_forest_mobod.h  # Defines SpanningForest::Mobod, the forest node carrying inboard_mobod/outboard_mobods, level, the q_start/nq and v_start/nv coordinate slices, the inboard path counts nq_inboard/nv_inboard (World to here, inclusive), the outboard subtree counts nq_outboard/nv_outboard and num_subtree_mobods with the contiguous subtree_velocities()/outboard_velocities() ranges that subtree passes slice with, the is_reversed flag telling the mobilizer its inboard/outboard order is flipped from parent/child, and the follower link ordinals of a composite.
vendor multibody/topology/spanning_forest_tree.h  # Defines SpanningForest::Tree, giving each tree its contiguous base_mobod..last_mobod range, height, begin/end iteration over that range, and the per-tree q_start/nq and v_start/nv slices used for tree-local state blocks.

# tree
vendor multibody/tree/acceleration_kinematics_cache.cc  # Emits the explicit double instantiation of AccelerationKinematicsCache.
vendor multibody/tree/acceleration_kinematics_cache.h  # Defines AccelerationKinematicsCache holding the per-MobodIndex A_WB spatial-acceleration pool plus the model-wide vdot vector that the base-to-tip acceleration pass and ABA forward dynamics write into.
vendor multibody/tree/articulated_body_force_cache.cc  # Emits the explicit double instantiation of ArticulatedBodyForceCache.
vendor multibody/tree/articulated_body_force_cache.h  # Stores the ABA bias terms Zplus_PB_W (residual spatial force projected across the inboard mobilizer) and e_B (innovations generalized force) indexed by MobodIndex, consumed by the ABA tip-to-base force pass.
vendor multibody/tree/articulated_body_inertia.cc  # Emits the explicit double instantiation of ArticulatedBodyInertia.
vendor multibody/tree/articulated_body_inertia.h  # Implements the ArticulatedBodyInertia value type: a lower-triangular-stored symmetric 6x6 that supports construction from SpatialInertia, Shift/ShiftInPlace across a mobilizer, and operator+= used by the ABA inertia recursion.
vendor multibody/tree/articulated_body_inertia_cache.cc  # Emits the explicit double instantiation of ArticulatedBodyInertiaCache.
vendor multibody/tree/articulated_body_inertia_cache.h  # Holds the first-ABA-pass results per mobod: P_B_W, Pplus_PB_W, the Eigen::LLT factorization of the hinge inertia D_B (via math::LinearSolver), and the Kalman gain g_PB_W = P_B_W*H_PB_W*D_B^-1.
vendor multibody/tree/ball_rpy_joint.cc  # Out-of-line BallRpyJoint bodies: type_name(), same-scalar DoShallowClone(), and MakeMobilizerForJoint, which picks inboard/outboard frames via tree_frames(mobod.is_reversed()) and constructs the RpyBallMobilizer the finalized tree runs.
vendor multibody/tree/ball_rpy_joint.h  # User-facing 3-DOF Joint that wraps RpyBallMobilizer with space x-y-z Euler angle coordinates, per-axis damping, and AddInTorque into MultibodyForces; G26 types its accessors on ORVD's state and evaluation-context contracts.
discard multibody/tree/block_system_jacobian_cache.cc  # The block system Jacobian is contract entry #5, and the runtime contract disposes of it as "no pre-allocated cache; computed directly in the first version, optimised only if a measurement says so". With no live consumer and G33 computing it directly, keeping the storage would be a cache nobody fills and nobody reads.
discard multibody/tree/block_system_jacobian_cache.h  # The block system Jacobian is contract entry #5, and the runtime contract disposes of it as "no pre-allocated cache; computed directly in the first version, optimised only if a measurement says so". With no live consumer and G33 computing it directly, keeping the storage would be a cache nobody fills and nobody reads.
vendor multibody/tree/body_node.cc  # Implements CalcCompositeBodyInertiaInWorld_TipToBase (the composite-body-inertia recursion that shifts each child's K_CCo_W to Bo for the mass matrix pass) and CalcArticulatedBodyHingeInertiaMatrixFactorization (LLT of D_B with the positive-definiteness diagnostic).
vendor multibody/tree/body_node.h  # Declares the BodyNode recursion interface (body/parent/mobilizer wiring, child_nodes, GetJacobianFromArray) and the virtual base-to-tip / tip-to-base entry points for position, velocity, acceleration, mass matrix, inverse dynamics, ABA inertia/force/acceleration, and composite body inertia.
vendor multibody/tree/body_node_impl.cc  # Defines the fixed-size per-mobilizer bodies of CalcPositionKinematicsCache_BaseToTip, CalcAcrossNodeJacobianWrtVExpressedInWorld, CalcVelocityKinematicsCache_BaseToTip, CalcSpatialAcceleration_BaseToTip, CalcInverseDynamics_TipToBase, the three ABA passes, and CalcSpatialAccelerationBias, then explicitly instantiates the double path for all admitted mobilizer types.
vendor multibody/tree/body_node_impl.h  # Declares BodyNodeImpl<T, ConcreteMobilizer>, the mobilizer-templated final BodyNode that inherits kNq/kNv/kNx and QVector/VVector/HMatrix fixed-size types so every recursion runs on compile-time-sized blocks.
vendor multibody/tree/body_node_impl_mass_matrix.cc  # Split-out continuation of body_node_impl.cc that defines CalcMassMatrixContributionViaWorld_TipToBase and the CalcMassMatrixOffDiagonalBlockViaWorld variants forming the O(n^2)-via-World mass matrix assembly, with the same double mobilizer instantiations.
vendor multibody/tree/body_node_world.h  # Provides BodyNodeWorld, the zero-dof terminal node for the World mobod whose overrides are all DRAKE_UNREACHABLE so the recursions can stop at Mobod 0 without a null check.
vendor multibody/tree/curvilinear_joint.cc  # Out-of-line CurvilinearJoint bodies: the constructor that stores the PiecewiseConstantCurvatureTrajectory and arc-length limits, type_name(), same-scalar DoShallowClone(), and MakeMobilizerForJoint, which hands curvilinear_path_ to a new CurvilinearMobilizer during finalization.
vendor multibody/tree/curvilinear_joint.h  # Single-DOF Joint whose coordinate is arc length s along a PiecewiseConstantCurvatureTrajectory; it is one of the concrete joint types in the admitted body-node instantiation set and requires the trajectory definition it stores by value. The upstream scalar-conversion dependency in that trajectory is removed at G16.
vendor multibody/tree/curvilinear_mobilizer.cc  # Defines the double X_FM(q), H_FM/Hdot_FM, ProjectSpatialForce, and N/N+ matrices for arc-length parameterization by delegating to the curvature trajectory.
vendor multibody/tree/curvilinear_mobilizer.h  # Declares the single-dof mobilizer whose hinge matrix in M is H_FM_M = [0 0 ρ(q) 1 0 0]ᵀ, moving frame M by arc length q along a planar piecewise-constant-curvature path. It is named in the BodyNodeImpl instantiation set and stores the trajectory definition it consumes; the upstream scalar-conversion dependency is removed at G16.
forbidden multibody/tree/deformable_body.cc  # Instantiates concrete FEM constitutive models (corotated, neohookean, linear), quadrature rules and the Newmark scheme, and registers deformable geometry with SceneGraph.
forbidden multibody/tree/deformable_body.h  # Owns an fem::FemModel plus a geometry::GeometryId over a volume mesh and MultibodyPlant deformable-constraint specs — three separately forbidden edges (fem, geometry, plant) in one header.
discard multibody/tree/door_hinge.cc  # Implements CalcApproximationCurves — the tanh(x/t) sigmoid with its singlet/doublet derivative curves — and the CalcHingeSpringTorque / CalcHingeFrictionalTorque / CalcHingeTorque built from it plus the potential-energy and conservative/non-conservative power terms; only useful if the door-hinge element itself is ever wanted.
discard multibody/tree/door_hinge.h  # A specialised ForceElement stacking empirical door spring, friction and catch torques onto one RevoluteJoint. No admitted runtime capability consumes it; it has no forbidden edge and can be re-adjudicated if a concrete consumer appears.
vendor multibody/tree/element_collection.cc  # Out-of-line template definitions (Add/Rename/Remove/index rebuild) plus the explicit instantiations for Frame, Joint, JointActuator, ModelInstance and Link; the trailing ElementCollection<T, DeformableBody, DeformableBodyIndex> instantiation block and its deformable_body.h include are the only forbidden contact and must be deleted when vendoring — the header itself is clean.
vendor multibody/tree/element_collection.h  # The container MultibodyTree stores its frames, joints, actuators, model instances and links in: index-addressed slots that tolerate holes, a packed iteration view, O(1) lookup by element->name() via a string hash map, and mixed owned/unowned ownership (needed because a RigidBodyFrame is owned by its RigidBody, not by the collection).
vendor multibody/tree/fixed_offset_frame.cc  # Implements get/set of X_PF through the typed FixedFramePoseParameters record and DoCalcPoseInBodyFrame/DoCalcRotationMatrixInBodyFrame, which recurse up the parent-frame chain to produce X_BF.
vendor multibody/tree/fixed_offset_frame.h  # The Frame subclass carrying a constant pose X_PF relative to a parent frame, stored as a 12-element numeric parameter so it can be retuned post-construction; this is the frame type used for essentially every joint frame F/M offset on a car body, bolster or axlebox.
forbidden multibody/tree/force_density_field.cc  # Defines the ForceDensityField/GravityForceField members declared in the forbidden fem-derived header, forwarding cache-entry and input-port declarations through MultibodyTreeSystemElementAttorney.
forbidden multibody/tree/force_density_field.h  # Extends the FEM base class fem::ForceDensityFieldBase to supply body-force density [N/m³] over a deformable volume, and its DeclareCacheEntries/DeclareInputPorts API is typed on MultibodyPlant<T>*; GravityForceField here is the deformable per-volume gravity, not the rigid-body UniformGravityFieldElement ORVD needs.
vendor multibody/tree/force_element.cc  # Provides the ForceElement destructor and the ShallowClone NVI whose default DoShallowClone throws a NiceTypeName-formatted 'failed to override' error; small but required to link the base class.
vendor multibody/tree/force_element.h  # The abstract base every force element ORVD needs derives from — it fixes the CalcAndAddForceContribution(context, position cache, velocity cache, MultibodyForces*) contract plus the potential-energy / conservative-power / non-conservative-power trio used for energy bookkeeping; gravity, linear spring-dampers and the roll-pitch-yaw bushing are all subclasses.
vendor multibody/tree/frame.cc  # Implements the retained relative-motion algebra — CalcAngularVelocity via w_MF = w_WF - w_WM re-expressed in E and the rearranged-composition CalcSpatialVelocity family — plus scoped_name() and internal::DeprecateWhenEmptyName(); force-free acceleration conveniences were removed in G27 while known-vdot acceleration remains tree-level.
vendor multibody/tree/frame.h  # Defines the material-frame abstraction: name plus the owning Link reference, typed X_BF/X_FB/is_X_BF_identity parameter access, and retained CalcPose / CalcSpatialVelocity queries relative to arbitrary measured-in and expressed-in frames; G26 routes state-only access through MultibodyStateInstance and cache-evaluating queries through RigidMultibodyTreeEvaluationContext.
vendor multibody/tree/frame_body_pose_cache.cc  # Emits the explicit double instantiation of FrameBodyPoseCache.
vendor multibody/tree/frame_body_pose_cache.h  # The parameter-dependent precomputation pool holding X_LF (frame pose on its link), X_BL/X_BF/X_FB (frame pose on its mobilized body, with identity flags for the fast path), and the mass properties M_LLo_L, M_BBo_B and p_BoLcm_B — the composite-mobod-aware inertia and pose data that position kinematics reads instead of recomputing each step.
forbidden multibody/tree/geometry_spatial_inertia.cc  # Integrates inertia over mesh tetrahedra by loading OBJ/VTK meshes and falling back to a convex hull, pulling four drake/geometry/proximity headers.
forbidden multibody/tree/geometry_spatial_inertia.h  # Its entire purpose is turning a geometry::Shape or geometry::TriangleSurfaceMesh into a SpatialInertia at a given density, so every declaration takes a drake/geometry type.
vendor multibody/tree/joint.cc  # Implements q/v accessors over ORVD's typed state and caller-owned array helpers, plus SetPose/GetPosePair/SetSpatialVelocity forwarding with ThrowIfNotFinalized guards.
vendor multibody/tree/joint.h  # The user-facing kinematic-pair abstraction over a mobilizer: owns frames F on parent and M on child, per-dof position/velocity/acceleration limits, default damping and positions, and AddInOneForce/AddInDamping. G26 deliberately removes runtime joint locking.
vendor multibody/tree/joint_actuator.cc  # Out-of-line JointActuator bodies: joint() resolved through get_parent_tree().get_joint(joint_index_), AddInOneForce forwarding tau to Joint::AddInOneForce, set_actuation_vector writing u->segment(input_start(), num_inputs()), num_inputs() = joint().num_velocities(), and effort-limit and PD-controller-gain validation.
vendor multibody/tree/joint_actuator.h  # Declares JointActuator, which owns the effort limit, per-actuator dof offset into u, AddInOneForce() that injects tau into MultibodyForces, and the rotor-inertia/gear-ratio pair whose product rho^2*Ir is the reflected inertia added to the mass-matrix diagonal.
vendor multibody/tree/linear_bushing_roll_pitch_yaw.cc  # Implements the bushing math: CalcR_AB for the halfway frame B midway between Ao and Co, the rpy angles and rates, tau = -(K012*q + D012*qdot) converted to a moment by t_Cp_A = Nᵀ*tau (N from RollPitchYaw::CalcMatrixRelatingRpyDtToAngularVelocityInParent), the gimbal-lock tolerance throw, and DoCalcAndAddForceContribution which shifts the resulting spatial force from Ao to link0's origin and adds the negated further-shifted copy at link1's origin.
vendor multibody/tree/linear_bushing_roll_pitch_yaw.h  # Declares the six-axis roll-pitch-yaw bushing force element with diagonal torque/force stiffness and damping matrices stored as runtime numeric parameters, i.e. exactly the compliant connection element ORVD needs for primary/secondary suspension bushings.
vendor multibody/tree/linear_spring_damper.cc  # Implements DoCalcAndAddForceContribution computing f_AP = (k*(l-l0) + c*dl/dt)*r_hat and shifting it into the per-body spatial-force array, plus CalcPotentialEnergy and CalcConservativePower for energy bookkeeping.
vendor multibody/tree/linear_spring_damper.h  # Declares the two-point finite-free-length spring-damper (points P on body A and Q on body B, parameters l0, k, c), the axial force element used for ORVD traction rods and vertical/lateral dampers.
vendor multibody/tree/mobilizer.cc  # Provides Mobilizer's out-of-line pieces: GetPosePair() converting X_FM into (quaternion, translation) and the throwing default bodies for DoMapAccelerationToQDDot, DoMapQDDotToAcceleration, DoCalcNDotMatrix and DoCalcNplusDotMatrix.
vendor multibody/tree/mobilizer.h  # Defines the across-mobilizer kinematics contract every joint type implements: X_FM(q), hinge matrix H_FM and its time derivative, ProjectSpatialForce (tau = H_FM^T * F), and the N(q)/N+(q) qdot-v coupling matrices; G26 separates typed-state access from cache-evaluating context access and removes runtime locking.
vendor multibody/tree/mobilizer_impl.cc  # Implements typed-state pose-to-q and spatial-velocity-to-v inverse hooks plus default-position writing, and carries the explicit instantiation list for the (nq,nv) sizes {0,0},{1,1},{2,2},{3,3},{6,6},{7,6} that every concrete mobilizer links against.
vendor multibody/tree/mobilizer_impl.h  # The MobilizerImpl<T, nq, nv> layer that fixes nq/nv at compile time, gives each concrete mobilizer typed fixed-size QVector/VVector views into the state, and documents the calc_X_FM / calc_V_FM / calc_A_FM / calc_tau inline contract that body_node_impl dispatches to allocation-free.
vendor multibody/tree/model_instance.cc  # Implements the per-instance gather/scatter of q, v and u by walking this instance's mobilizers and actuators and copying their contiguous blocks in and out of the model-wide arrays.
vendor multibody/tree/model_instance.h  # Declares ModelInstance, which accumulates per-submodel q, v and actuated-dof counts and provides positions, velocities and actuation slicing. This is the admitted tree's existing mechanism for addressing one submodel inside the complete state vector.
vendor multibody/tree/multibody_element.cc  # Implements element lifetime and ownership checks, typed-state layout identity validation, and the private NVI forwarding used while Finalize assigns typed parameter slots and installs defaults.
vendor multibody/tree/multibody_element.h  # Base class giving every tree element its ModelInstanceIndex, type-safe index_impl<>, ephemeral flag and parent-tree back pointer; G26 replaces framework declaration hooks with private typed parameter-slot/default-value NVIs and removes generic cache/discrete-state declaration.
vendor multibody/tree/multibody_forces.cc  # Implements constructors that size F_B_W and tau from a finalized tree or explicit dimensions, plus AddInForces and the CheckHasRightSizeForModel size guard; the former tree-system overload left with G27's reverse-pointer removal.
vendor multibody/tree/multibody_forces.h  # Declares the force accumulator that every force element writes into: a per-MobodIndex std::vector<SpatialForce> F_B_W plus the generalized-force vector tau, with SetZero and AddInForces superposition.
vendor multibody/tree/multibody_tree-inl.h  # Holds the template bodies MultibodyTree's header only declares: AddFrame/AddMobilizer/AddJoint/AddEphemeralJoint/AddForceElement/AddJointActuator/AddModelInstance construction and registration, and the get_positions/get_velocities/get_mutable_* accessors that carve q and v out of the state vector.
vendor multibody/tree/multibody_tree.cc  # Contains the actual recursions: base-to-tip and tip-to-base sweeps over BodyNodes for kinematics, the composite-body and ABA passes, force-element accumulation, spatial momentum and center-of-mass computations, and the ephemeral-joint/mobilizer synthesis performed during Finalize.
vendor multibody/tree/multibody_tree.h  # Declares MultibodyTree itself: element ownership and name lookup, Finalize/topology, the position/velocity/acceleration kinematics cache passes, CalcMassMatrix and CalcMassMatrixViaInverseDynamics, CalcInverseDynamics, CalcBiasTerm, the full articulated-body-algorithm triple (inertia cache, force bias, force cache, accelerations), and all CalcJacobian* variants — the single most load-bearing header in this extraction.
vendor multibody/tree/multibody_tree_indexes.h  # Defines the TypeSafeIndex aliases the entire tree is addressed by (BodyIndex/LinkIndex, LinkOrdinal, FrameIndex, JointIndex/JointOrdinal, ForceElementIndex, JointActuatorIndex, ModelInstanceIndex, internal MobodIndex and TreeIndex) plus world_index()/world_mobod_index(); the DeformableBodyId and DeformableBodyIndex aliases here are bare type declarations with no deformable dependency and should simply be deleted.
first_party multibody/tree/multibody_tree_system.cc  # Besides the cache and continuous-state declarations in Finalize(), this file holds DeclareMultibodyElementParameters() and SetDefaultParameters() — the loops that declare and default each element's numeric parameters — plus the ABA forward-dynamics driver CalcArticulatedBodyForceCache/CalcForwardDynamicsContinuous. ORVD must reimplement those responsibilities, not just store state.
first_party multibody/tree/multibody_tree_system.h  # Entire class is the LeafSystem wrapper that owns a MultibodyTree and declares its Context resources: it derives from systems::LeafSystem<T> and exposes EvalFrameBodyPoses/EvalPositionKinematics/EvalVelocityKinematics/EvalForwardDynamics as CacheEntry::Eval calls, so ORVD must reimplement this layer against its own runtime/cache contract.
first_party multibody/tree/parameter_conversion.h  # Its whole content is packing/unpacking a SpatialInertia into a 10-coordinate systems::BasicVector so mass properties can live as a Context numeric parameter. ORVD refused that transport format at G21: mass properties are a RigidBodyInertiaParameters record whose fields say what each number is. What remains at G26 is two named conversions between that record and SpatialInertia<double>, in the adapter; the anonymous ten-element layout is not reproduced.

discard common/default_scalars.h  # Supplies the DRAKE_DECLARE/DEFINE_*_INSTANTIATIONS_ON_DEFAULT_SCALARS macros used at 110 sites in multibody/tree; its own closure is 69 files of AutoDiff and symbolic machinery. vendor common/drake_assert.h  # Defines DRAKE_ASSERT, DRAKE_ASSERT_VOID, DRAKE_DEMAND, DRAKE_THROW_UNLESS, DRAKE_UNREACHABLE and DRAKE_DEREF, plus the drake::assert::ConditionTraits customization point used throughout the admitted tree and topology. G16 collapsed T to double, where boolean<double> is bool and every `if constexpr (scalar_predicate<T>::is_bool)` branch is taken; the declarations that named boolean<T> now say bool, so this abstraction has no remaining meaning and no consumer.
vendor common/drake_copyable.h  # Defines the three class-body macros DRAKE_NO_COPY_NO_MOVE_NO_ASSIGN, DRAKE_DEFAULT_COPY_AND_MOVE_AND_ASSIGN and DRAKE_DECLARE_COPY_AND_MOVE_AND_ASSIGN that fix copy/move/assign semantics in 54 tree and topology classes (Joint, Mobilizer, MultibodyTree, MultibodyElement, RotationalInertia, SpatialInertia, the kinematics caches, ElementCollection); it is a pure preprocessor header with zero drake includes, so it vendors standalone at no dependency cost.

vendor common/never_destroyed.h  # Provides never_destroyed<T>, an in-place storage wrapper whose destructor never runs, used for function-local statics without static-destruction-order or leak-checker noise; seven vendored joint sources return their type_name() through it — curvilinear_joint.cc:46, revolute_joint.cc:46, prismatic_joint.cc:46, screw_joint.cc:46, universal_joint.cc:15, weld_joint.cc:15 and quaternion_floating_joint.h:104 — and nice_type_name.h:61 uses it to cache the demangled name per type, so removing it would require rewriting all of those. vendor math/unit_vector.h  # Declares math::internal::ThrowIfNotUnitVector and NormalizeOrThrow plus the kToleranceUnitVectorNorm = 1e-14 constant, which UnitInertia::AxiallySymmetric/StraightLine/ThinRod/SolidCylinder (unit_inertia.cc) and spatial_inertia.cc call to validate their axis arguments; the definitions live in math/unit_vector.cc, which must be vendored with it and which currently includes math/autodiff.h purely for the non-double instantiations that G16 removes.
vendor math/wrap_to.h  # Provides the single free function math::wrap_to(value, low, high), which folds a periodic coordinate into [low, high); its live consumer is not the tree but the vendored common/trajectories/piecewise_constant_curvature_trajectory.h:301, whose inline maybe_wrap() calls math::wrap_to(s, T(0.), length()) to fold arclength s onto a closed (periodic) track centerline — so it is structurally required for the curvilinear path. Its include in multibody/tree/curvilinear_mobilizer.h:12 is genuinely dead and may be deleted, and its only remaining drake dep is common/drake_assert.h; G16 removed the dead include in multibody/tree/curvilinear_mobilizer.h and the common/double_overloads.h include, whose sole use was a commented-out alternative implementation.
vendor multibody/math/spatial_algebra.h  # The mandatory entry point for the spatial-vector types: it defines DRAKE_SPATIAL_ALGEBRA_HEADER before including the four spatial value headers, whose compile-time guards require this include order. It transitively requires spatial_vector.h and convert_time_derivative.h.
first_party systems/framework/context.h  # Defines systems::Context<T>, the per-instance value store (time, continuous/discrete/abstract state, numeric and abstract parameters, accuracy) that is the first argument of nearly every query in mobilizer.h, joint.h, rigid_body.h, multibody_tree.h and multibody_tree_system.h; ORVD substitutes its own runtime state/parameter contract for it during G20–G28, and copying it would import the whole framework layer (ContextBase, cache/dependency tracker, Parameters, State, type-erased AbstractValue).

# architecture-level decisions on the second support layer
discard common/symbolic/expression.h  # The symbolic scalar type, whose own closure is 68 files. Reached only through default-scalar instantiation and through math/linear_solve.h's symbolic specialisation; neither survives G16, so ORVD deletes those consumers rather than admitting the tree behind them.
discard math/autodiff.h  # Re-exports the AutoDiffXd Eigen bindings for gradient extraction; reached only from math/linear_solve.h's AutoDiff specialisation, which G16 removes along with the rest of the non-double instantiations.
discard math/autodiff_gradient.h  # Provides ExtractGradient/InitializeAutoDiff over AutoDiffXd matrices and opens a third independent door to <fmt/format.h>; used only by the AutoDiff branch of math/linear_solve.h, which does not exist in a double-only build.
vendor math/fast_pose_composition_functions.h  # Declares ComposeRR/ComposeRinvR/ComposeXX/ComposeXinvX, which math/rotation_matrix.h and math/rigid_transform.h call unconditionally on the double path. The header has no Highway dependency and is admitted with its upstream performance claims removed; only its upstream implementation is refused.
first_party math/fast_pose_composition_functions.cc  # Upstream implements these four compositions through Google Highway, whose closure is an additional third-party dependency the product does not admit. ORVD supplies its own implementation from the mathematical definitions in orvd_implementations/; copying upstream's portable branch and calling it first-party is expressly not allowed.
discard systems/framework/scalar_conversion_traits.h  # G16 removed PiecewiseConstantCurvatureTrajectory's cross-scalar ValueConverter alias and constructor; no admitted source names this framework scalar-conversion mechanism, and ORVD does not replace an API it intentionally does not publish.

# second support layer
vendor common/constants.h  # Declares enum class ToleranceType. The admitted code does not use that enum directly, but common/eigen_types.h and math/cross_product.h include the dependency-free header unconditionally, so it stays rather than patching two unrelated headers.
discard common/double_overloads.h  # Supplied `drake::if_then_else(bool, double, double)`, the double resolution target for branch-free code written so symbolic expressions could avoid control flow. On double the construct is the conditional operator, so G16 wrote the seven remaining call sites as `?:` or as an `if`, and nothing includes this header.
vendor common/drake_assert.cc  # Sole definition of drake::internal::Abort, AssertionFailed and Throw (drake_assert.h only declares them), plus the AssertionConfig singleton, the fmt_eigen(...) wrapper-stripping of value names, and explicit instantiations of StringifyErrorDetailValue for float/double/int/size_t/string/string_view/const char* — without it every DRAKE_DEMAND and DRAKE_THROW_UNLESS in multibody/tree is an unresolved symbol; note it pulls in fmt/format.h and fmt/ranges.h, so fmtlib joins Eigen as an external dependency.
discard common/drake_deprecated.cc  # Only defines the drake::internal::WarnDeprecated constructor (env-var-driven runtime deprecation warning), but the DRAKE_DEPRECATED macro expands to a plain [[deprecated]] attribute with no link-time dependency, and repo-wide the only WarnDeprecated constructions are in pydrake bindings — nothing in multibody/tree, multibody/topology, math or common ever instantiates it, so linking it would only drag in text_logging/spdlog for dead code.
discard common/extract_double.h  # Provided `ExtractDoubleOrThrow`, which on a double argument returns it unchanged. G16 wrote its thirteen call sites as the expressions they wrapped; the roadmap lists ExtractDouble among the constructs the double-only boundary must not consume, and no file includes this header (nothing did even before the cut, since the include arrived through the discarded common/default_scalars.h).
vendor common/fmt.cc  # Defines fmt_debug_string and explicitly instantiates fmt_floating_point<float>/<double> (fmt.h declares both but leaves the bodies here) — these are what drake_assert.cc's StringifyErrorDetailValue calls to render numeric and string values inside DRAKE_THROW_UNLESS messages, so it must be linked alongside drake_assert.cc.
vendor common/fmt_eigen.cc  # Defines drake::internal::FormatMatrix, the bracket/padding/transpose layout engine that fmt_eigen.h's formatter delegates to at line 275 but only declares at line 45, plus the explicit StringifyErrorDetailValue<fmt_eigen_ref<double/float/int/string>> instantiations; the one genuine double-path requirement is math/unit_vector.cc, which calls fmt_eigen() at line 35 (inside NormalizeOrThrow's `if constexpr (scalar_predicate<T>::is_bool)` true-branch) and line 74 (inside ThrowIfNotUnitVector's true-branch), both of which are the double instantiations that unit_inertia.cc and spatial_inertia.cc reach through their ThrowIfNotUnitVector calls.
vendor common/hash.h  # Defines the hash_append protocol overloads (integral, pointer, enum, floating-point, string, pair, optional, map, set, plus hash_append_range), the `uhash` functor, the FNV1a `DefaultHasher`/`DefaultHash` aliases and `DelegatingHasher`; common/type_safe_index.h uses it so BodyIndex, MobodIndex, JointIndex and the other rigid-tree indices can be unordered-map keys, and common/sorted_pair.h, math/rotation_matrix.h, math/rigid_transform.h and math/roll_pitch_yaw.h do the same.
discard common/identifier.cc  # Its only symbol, drake::internal::get_new_identifier(), serves Identifier<Tag>. G15 removes the only admitted Identifier aliases and discards both identifier.h and this implementation.
discard common/is_approx_equal_abstol.h  # Reached the G15 closure only because math/quaternion.h:21 included it unconditionally, for the test-only IsQuaternionAndQuaternionDtEqualAngularVelocityExpressedInB. G16 discarded that header outright, so nothing includes this one.
vendor common/nice_type_name.cc  # Defines NiceTypeName demangling, canonicalization, namespace removal and the optional override used by error diagnostics throughout the admitted tree. It requires nice_type_name_override.cc. Preserve the file's Stanford copyright and Apache-2.0 notice verbatim. Its <cxxabi.h> include and abi::__cxa_demangle call sit inside a __GNUG__ guard, so this is a platform header rather than a third-party dependency and the non-GNU branch returns the raw typeid name.
discard common/pointer_cast.cc  # A four-line file containing only an include directive for pointer_cast.h and a comment; it is a standalone-header compile check and emits no symbols, while the casts are inline templates in the header.
discard common/random.cc  # Defines RandomGenerator::CreateEngine plus probability-density instantiations. All admitted callers belong to the symbolic random-state APIs that G16 deletes together with their declarations; no double runtime API may retain RandomGenerator after that cut.
vendor common/string_hash.h  # Defines `internal::StringHash`, the transparent (is_transparent) hash functor that makes `drake::string_unordered_map` accept string_view/const char* lookup keys without allocating; it is a direct dependency of common/string_unordered_map.h, which multibody/tree/element_collection.h:9 and multibody/topology/link_joint_graph.h:18 / .cc:12 use for their name-to-element index tables, and it is entirely scalar-agnostic.
vendor common/trajectories/piecewise_constant_curvature_trajectory.cc  # Holds the out-of-line bodies of the validating constructor, CalcPose, CalcSpatialVelocity/CalcSpatialVelocityInM, CalcSpatialAcceleration/CalcSpatialAccelerationInM, EndpointsAreNearlyEqual, DoClone and the private MakeInitialPose/MakeBreakPoses/CalcRelativePoseInSegment, plus the explicit class instantiation the header only DECLAREs; CurvilinearMobilizer<double> stores a PiecewiseConstantCurvatureTrajectory<double> member and calls CalcPose/CalcSpatialVelocityInM/CalcSpatialAccelerationInM directly on the double path (curvilinear_mobilizer.cc:87-113). ORVD must replace the DEFINE_..._ON_DEFAULT_SCALARS macro with a plain `template class ...<double>;`.
vendor common/trajectories/piecewise_trajectory.h  # Declares the `PiecewiseTrajectory<T>` base class that owns the break-point vector and the segment lookup (get_segment_index, get_segment_times, is_time_in_range, kEpsilonTime, SegmentTimesEqual); it is the direct base of PiecewiseConstantCurvatureTrajectory (piecewise_constant_curvature_trajectory.h:75-76), which multibody/tree/curvilinear_mobilizer.h:248 and multibody/tree/curvilinear_joint.h:378 hold by value, so the class definition must be complete at those points — note the vendored copy must drop the common/default_scalars.h include and replace the trailing DRAKE_DECLARE_CLASS_TEMPLATE_INSTANTIATIONS_ON_DEFAULT_SCALARS with a plain `extern template class PiecewiseTrajectory<double>`, since its out-of-line members live in piecewise_trajectory.cc.
vendor common/type_safe_index.cc  # Defines ThrowTypeSafeIndexAssertValidFailed and ThrowTypeSafeIndexAssertNoOverflowFailed, the two [[noreturn]] helpers declared in type_safe_index.h and referenced from the DRAKE_ASSERT_VOID-guarded AssertValid/AssertNoOverflow inside every TypeSafeIndex operator; since BodyIndex, MobodIndex, JointIndex etc. in multibody/tree and multibody/topology are all TypeSafeIndex, any assert-enabled double build needs these symbols.
discard math/cross_product.cc  # Empty placeholder that only includes math/cross_product.h to prove the header is self-contained; VectorToSkewSymmetric and friends are inline templates, so the multibody/tree consumers (spatial_inertia.h, articulated_body_inertia.h) get everything from the header and this translation unit contributes no code to link.
discard math/linear_solve.cc  # Empty placeholder that only includes math/linear_solve.h; the LinearSolver wrapper and GetLinearSolver used by body_node.h/body_node_impl.cc/articulated_body_inertia_cache.h are entirely header-inline templates, so nothing in this translation unit is ever needed at link time.
discard math/quaternion.cc  # Supplies out-of-line bodies for exactly three declared-only templates — AreQuaternionsEqualForOrientation, CalculateQuaternionDtFromAngularVelocityExpressedInB, CalculateAngularVelocityExpressedInBFromQuaternionDt — whose only in-repo caller inside math/ is the header template IsQuaternionAndQuaternionDtEqualAngularVelocityExpressedInB (math/quaternion.h:316), and that template is itself instantiated nowhere outside math/test/quaternion_test.cc and multibody/benchmarks/free_body tests; the sole non-test use anywhere is multibody/benchmarks/free_body/free_body.cc:89, and quaternion_floating_mobilizer.cc included math/quaternion.h while naming none of them (G16 removed that include, then the header), so the double-only tree links without this TU — and its DRAKE_DEFINE_FUNCTION_TEMPLATE_INSTANTIATIONS_ON_DEFAULT_SCALARS would drag in the discarded common/default_scalars.h regardless.
discard math/random_rotation.cc  # An empty translation unit containing only an include directive for random_rotation.h; it proves the header is self-contained and defines no symbol.
vendor math/rigid_transform.cc  # Defines GetAsIsometry3, vector4 validation, to_string and stream output declared by RigidTransform. G15 keeps the translation unit so the copied public class is complete; G16 narrows its explicit instantiation to double and may delete an API only together with its declaration.
vendor math/roll_pitch_yaw.cc  # Keep it for SetFromRotationMatrix/SetFromQuaternion(AndRotationMatrix), ToQuaternion, ToRotationMatrix, CalcRotationMatrixDt, CalcRotationMatrixDrDpDy, the rpy-to-omega maps, CalcRpyDDt and gimbal-lock diagnostics used by admitted mobilizers and the bushing. G16 removes scalar-specific bodies and matching declarations while retaining the double paths.
vendor math/rotation_matrix.cc  # The only definition site for MakeX/Y/ZRotation, the RollPitchYaw constructor, MakeFromOneUnitVector, QuaternionToRotationMatrix, ToQuaternion(Matrix3), validity checks and axial-rotation helpers used on the double path. G16 removes AutoDiff-specific bodies and replaces surviving ExtractDouble calls without adding a compatibility shim.
vendor math/unit_vector.cc  # The only definition of math::internal::ThrowIfNotUnitVector and NormalizeOrThrow. G16 removes the two non-double DiscardGradient paths and keeps direct double values without a compatibility shim.
vendor multibody/math/spatial_acceleration.h  # Defines `SpatialAcceleration<T>` with ShiftInPlace/Shift (the 33-flop rigid shift adding alpha x p plus the centripetal term), ShiftWithZeroAngularVelocity and ComposeWithMovingFrameAcceleration (the Coriolis/centrifugal composition used when a child mobilizer frame moves on its parent), which is the return/accumulator type of the whole acceleration kinematics pass — multibody/tree/body_node.h, body_node_impl.h, body_node_world.h, mobilizer_impl.h and every concrete mobilizer (revolute, prismatic, screw, planar, weld, curvilinear, quaternion_floating), plus frame.h, rigid_body.h, spatial_inertia.h and articulated_body_inertia.h, all depend on it; it must be reached through multibody/math/spatial_algebra.h because of the DRAKE_SPATIAL_ALGEBRA_HEADER guard at line 3.
discard multibody/math/spatial_algebra.cc  # Defines nothing of its own — every member and free operator of SpatialVelocity/SpatialAcceleration/SpatialForce/SpatialMomentum is already inline in the spatial_*.h headers, and this file's entire content is four DRAKE_DEFINE_CLASS_TEMPLATE_INSTANTIATIONS_ON_DEFAULT_SCALARS calls whose only purpose is to satisfy the matching extern-template DECLAREs, which disappear along with the discarded common/default_scalars.h, leaving the headers to instantiate implicitly at each use site.
vendor multibody/math/spatial_force.h  # Defines SpatialForce<T>, the torque-on-top-of-force 6-vector (with ShiftInPlace/Shift moment transfer) that every mobilizer's ProjectSpatialForce, BodyNode inverse-dynamics/ABA force propagation, MultibodyForces, and UniformGravityFieldElement pass around on the double path.
vendor multibody/math/spatial_momentum.h  # Defines SpatialMomentum<T> (angular momentum h over linear momentum l) with its about-point Shift, which is the return type of SpatialInertia<T>::operator*(SpatialVelocity) at multibody/tree/spatial_inertia.cc:437 and of MultibodyTree::CalcSpatialMomentumInWorldAboutPoint / CalcBodiesSpatialMomentumInWorldAboutWo.
vendor multibody/math/spatial_velocity.h  # Defines SpatialVelocity<T> with ShiftInPlace and ComposeWithMovingFrameVelocity — the recursion kernel of VelocityKinematicsCache and every mobilizer's CalcAcrossMobilizerSpatialVelocity — and is also where the out-of-line dot() members of SpatialForce (power) and SpatialMomentum (twice kinetic energy) are actually defined, so force/momentum users need it too.

# third support layer
vendor multibody/math/spatial_vector.h  # Defines the CRTP base SpatialVector<SV, T> that gives SpatialVelocity, SpatialAcceleration, SpatialForce and SpatialMomentum their shared 6-element rotational-over-translational storage, rotational()/translational() accessors, IsApprox and the arithmetic operators; every spatial_*.h derives from it, so the whole kinematics and dynamics recursion depends on it.
vendor math/convert_time_derivative.h  # Provides ConvertTimeDerivativeToOtherFrame, the transport theorem DtA(v) = DtB(v) + w_AB x v; SpatialAcceleration<T>::ComposeWithMovingFrameAcceleration uses it to add the Coriolis term when a mobilizer frame moves on its parent.
discard common/cond.h  # Defined drake::cond(), the recursive branch-free selector that expands (condition, value) pairs into if_then_else chains. Nothing outside the header ever called it, and the two headers built on it are discarded with the branch-free forms themselves.
discard common/double_overloads.cc  # Empty self-containment translation unit; all double if_then_else and cond overloads are inline in the header, so copying it would add no implementation.
vendor common/drake_assertion_error.h  # Defines drake::internal::assertion_error, the std::runtime_error subclass that DRAKE_THROW_UNLESS and drake::internal::Throw raise; every precondition check in the admitted tree ends here, and common/drake_assert.cc constructs it by name.
discard common/hash.cc  # Empty self-containment translation unit; hash_append and DefaultHasher are inline in the header, so it defines no symbol.
vendor common/nice_type_name_override.h  # Declares type_erased_ptr and SetNiceTypeNamePtrOverride, the hook common/nice_type_name.cc consults so a caller can substitute its own runtime type naming; nice_type_name.cc calls it unconditionally, so the declaration must be present to compile that admitted unit.
vendor common/trajectories/trajectory.h  # Declares the abstract Trajectory<T> interface (value, start_time, end_time, rows, cols, MakeDerivative) that PiecewiseTrajectory<T> derives from, so the base of CurvilinearJoint's and CurvilinearMobilizer's path type is incomplete without it.
vendor common/trajectories/piecewise_trajectory.cc  # Sole definition site of PiecewiseTrajectory<T>::start_time/end_time/duration, GetSegmentTimesFromBreaks, get_segment_index and segment_number_range_check, which piecewise_constant_curvature_trajectory.h calls for every arc-length lookup on the curvilinear path; the header only declares them.
discard common/cond.cc  # Empty self-containment translation unit; cond() is an inline variadic template in the header and this file defines no symbol.
vendor common/nice_type_name_override.cc  # Sole definition of SetNiceTypeNamePtrOverride and of the never_destroyed singleton holding the override pointer; common/nice_type_name.cc reads that singleton on every Get() call, so omitting this leaves an unresolved symbol in an admitted unit.
vendor common/trajectories/trajectory.cc  # Sole definition site of Trajectory<T>'s destructor, Clone, vector_values, EvalDerivative and MakeDerivative; PiecewiseTrajectory<T> inherits them and the curvilinear path type is destroyed and copied through this base, so the vtable and these bodies must exist.
